summary.text: Linda Ryan is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 4 who is seeking a third term in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired public school teacher from Nashua, she describes herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a moderate Democrat.

paragraphs.text: Linda Ryan was born in Norfolk, Virginia, and earned a B.A. from The College of Saint Rose in 1979 and an M.Ed. from Rivier University in 1999.
Before retiring, her career included working as a public school teacher, a middle and high school track and field coach, and a case worker.
She has served as a Nashua city conservation commissioner and a Nashua child care commissioner, and as a United Way volunteer.
Ryan assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 7, 2022, and in the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she also serves on the Hillsborough County Executive Committee and worked on the county budget for 2025 and 2026.
She listed public funding for public schools, natural resource protection including clean water, and property tax reform without an income tax among her key messages.
